ordering_constraint.note: This file and prereg_objA.md are frozen before either FiQA2018 pack is built. The timestamp records the scope date; filesystem and artifact hashes provide the execution audit trail.

primary_hypothesis: A univariate OLS using oracle_margin_mean predicts ridge oracle-gap recovery R better than both frozen trivial nulls under blocked leave-one-out validation.

target.name: R
target.non_positive_oracle_gap: Log the regime as unavailable and exclude it; do not alter the target or manufacture a positive gap.

primary_metric.name: block-LOO Spearman(R_hat, R)
primary_metric.spearman: Pearson correlation of average-tie ranks over all out-of-fold cell predictions and observed R values.
primary_metric.secondary_required_metric: block-LOO mean absolute error over the same out-of-fold cells
primary_metric.undefined_metric_policy: Record null if either ranked vector has zero variance; an undefined metric cannot satisfy a strict-beat comparison.

nulls.name: oracle_gap_ols
nulls.definition: Univariate OLS with intercept from oracle_gap to R, fit on the same training cells as the primary predictor.

nulls.name: mean_R
nulls.definition: Training-cell mean R, computed independently inside each identical block-LOO fold.

beat_definition: The primary predictor must have strictly greater Spearman and strictly lower MAE than each null. Ties, null metrics, and equality are failures.

block_loo.training_exclusion: Every cell whose block label equals the held-out label is excluded from every model and null fit for that fold.
block_loo.aggregation: Concatenate exactly one out-of-fold prediction per available independent dataset x encoder-family pair, then compute Spearman and MAE at cell level while reporting held-out-unit count and independent-pair block-n.

partial_spearman.locked_definition: Average-rank oracle_margin_mean, R, and oracle_gap across the available independent pairs. OLS-residualize ranked oracle_margin_mean and ranked R separately on an intercept plus ranked oracle_gap. Pearson-correlate the two residual vectors.
partial_spearman.scope: One full-sample descriptive partial correlation across independent dataset x encoder-family pairs; it is not substituted for either primary block-LOO metric.
additional_descriptives: raw Spearman difference: margin minus gap

offline_scope.oom_policy: Use conservative batch sizes and release model/GPU memory between sequential regimes; do not parallelize pack builds.

pseudo_replication_rule: Drift-magnitude or anchor-fraction variants of an existing dataset and encoder-family pair may be logged as cells but do not increment independent-pair block-n and may not pad the primary analysis. No such variants are registered here.

requirements: margin beats oracle_gap_ols on Spearman and MAE under dataset-block LOO
margin beats mean_R on Spearman and MAE under dataset-block LOO
margin beats oracle_gap_ols on Spearman and MAE under encoder-family-block LOO
margin beats mean_R on Spearman and MAE under encoder-family-block LOO
success_bar.gap_failure_rule: If margin fails to beat oracle_gap_ols under either block scheme on either required metric, the scientific result is NEGATIVE.
success_bar.power_rule: Power claims use independent-pair block-n, never hyperparameter cell count. The dataset and encoder holdout-unit counts are also reported.

verdict_policy.reason: The offline cache caps the experiment at three dataset holdout units and two encoder-family holdout units.

required_reporting: per-regime oracle_margin_mean, oracle_gap, floor_ndcg, and R
primary and both null out-of-fold predictions
block-LOO Spearman and MAE under both block schemes
independent-pair block-n, cell-n, dataset holdout-unit count, and encoder-family holdout-unit count
all skipped or degenerate regimes with reasons
